title: ACHAL node telemetry v1
description: One reading from one surface node, as published by the gateway on achal/{site}/telemetry/{node}.

path.description: Relay nodes from source to gateway

neighbour_rssi.description: RSSI heard from each neighbour, used as a relative-distance signal

ext_mm.description: Wire extensometer change to the next node

buffered.description: True if this reading was held in the gateway buffer while offline

truth.description: Simulation only: ground-truth labels, stripped before the risk engine in eval mode

event.description: none | blast | trough | precursor | collapse | fire

fault.description: Injected sensor fault: stuck | spike | drift | battery

hazard.description: True only while a real ground hazard affects this node

onset_ts.description: When the scenario's hazard process began

failure_ts.description: Collapse time, or when trough damage thresholds are first passed
